No keyboards or pedalboard are visible in this cropped view.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the instrument as a pipe organ and distinguish it from other keyboard instruments or architectural facades.
To verify the physical depth relationship between the pipes and the wooden case, ensuring pipes appear correctly recessed or mounted rather than floating or melted into the background.
To check for boundary artifacts such as bleeding between individual pipes or fusion with the wooden grille/case, which are common AI generation errors in repetitive structures.

focus_areas: Symmetry and alignment of vertical pipes
Boundary sharpness between metal pipes and wooden case
Consistency of metallic texture and reflections on pipes
Structural plausibility of the wooden casing details
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the regularity of the pipes. AI often struggles with repeating vertical lines, causing slight warping or inconsistent spacing. Check if the 'grille' patterns above the pipes are logically consistent or if they dissolve into noise. Verify that the perspective of the wooden panels aligns with the camera angle.
